title: Tap Sprint
description: A 100-metre dash against three computer runners! Tap as fast as you can to sprint — and don't forget to lean at the finish line.
instructions: Alternate the Left and Right arrow keys (or A and D) as fast as you can.
On touch screens, tap the two big buttons one after the other.
Press Space near the finish line to lean for extra speed.
Beat the other runners to win gold.
